description: Work with API documentation built on Stoplight Elements, Stoplight's open-source toolkit for interactive API docs. Read any public Stoplight project the way Elements Dev Portal does: its versions, every page in its sidebar, one article, API, endpoint or model in full, and a search of everything it says. Save an API's OpenAPI document as a file, and call its hosted mock server to see what the API would answer. Build standalone pages with Elements - an API reference from any OpenAPI document, or a whole developer portal from a Stoplight project - to host anywhere. No account or API key required.
